verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is documented as a terminal coding agent that runs locally against your own toolchain. Its `--sandbox workspace-write` flag is a local permission mode, and "cloud" in the docs refers only to model providers. Nothing in the evidence describes configuring a reproducible cloud environment with dependencies or setup steps, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs
